integrity: Complete graph-coordinate definitions, a general all-parameter proof, and a standalone exact-integer finite checker are supplied. Finite checks do not certify infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Equal leaf-bundle size and clique core only. Resonant endpoint norm remains a finite Krawtchouk sum. Historical-priority comparison is bounded; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Clique coronas: exact Walsh multiplier spectrum and sharp range-projection norms
